transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, October 15. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'India have totally spoiled Sooryavanshi's confidence': Ex-cricketer makes bold claim. Former India captain Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticised the team management for frequently changing the opening combination, saying it has hurt Sanju Samson and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's confidence. He questioned Samson's inconsistency and suggested giving both players more opportunities. Meanwhile, West Indies defeated India by 24 runs in the fourth T20I, with Shai Hope scoring an unbeaten century to level the series 2-2. Jeff Bezos's Spaceport: Ranch deal built Blue Origin base; space tourism costs stay high. Jeff Bezos acquired 165,000 acres of land in West Texas to develop Blue Origin's spaceflight operations. The company launched its first crewed flight on July 20, 2021, with four passengers aboard. This historic mission marked significant milestones in commercial space travel and the efforts to expand human access to space. Blue Origin aims to make space travel available for more people beyond government programs. Tyler Perry turned 330-acre former Army base into major Atlanta film studio. In 2015, Tyler Perry acquired the former Fort McPherson Army base in Atlanta for $30 million, and transformed it into a major production hub featuring 12 sound stages. This initiative not only aims to create new jobs but also emphasizes the importance of preserving historical structures while meeting the evolving demands of the film industry. Perry's vision includes nurturing local talent to foster growth in South Atlanta's creative landscape. Mumbai ATC software glitch behind Air India false hijack scare? Probe on. A false hijack alert created a real scare for security agencies and the 306 people on board Air India's Frankfurt-Delhi flight on Wednesday, with the Boeing 787 getting diverted to Jaipur as a result where everyone had to wait for hours before they could fly to their destination. 5 wickets in an over! SA bowler makes history with rare feat - Watch. Laycock finished with career-best figures of 6/26, including a record of four wickets in four consecutive deliveries in South African T20 cricket. Delhi Police detains Ankita Bhandari's parents, oppn leaders from India Gate. Ankita Bhandari's parents, along with several opposition leaders and protesters, were detained by Delhi Police at India Gate after an overnight protest. rupees 53k crore IDBI stake sale with LIC takes government past selloff target. Government and LIC will sell a combined 60.7 percent in IDBI Bank for rupees 52,878 crore to an arm of Fairfax Financial Holdings, which is controlled by Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa, that will result in the largest-ever financial sector FDI in the country. Mike Tyson sued for £1.5M over Rabona deal, denies breach. Mike Tyson and his wife, Lakiha, are facing a £1.5 million High Court legal battle over a Rabona sponsorship deal. The gambling company alleges Tyson breached his contract after withdrawing from a campaign involving a giant talking pigeon. Tyson and his promotional business, Tyrannic, deny breaching the agreement. The hearing is continuing in London. India to Starlink: Comply with rules before entering market. Starlink is yet to receive clearance to launch services in India as it has not agreed to comply with regulations requiring satellite internet providers to set up domestic infrastructure, a senior govt official said Wednesday, sending a tough message to tech trillionaire Elon Musk that in order to do business in India he will have to abide by the law of the land. Edible Schoolyard turns 31, now spans 5,800 programs in 75 countries. Launched back in 1995 in California, the Edible Schoolyard Project has blossomed into a global initiative founded by chef Alice Waters. The project imparts essential lessons on gardening and environmental stewardship, seamlessly integrating with subjects like science and math. With a mission to foster healthy eating habits, it has inspired educational platforms across more than 75 countries, aiming to weave food education into everyday school curricula for enhanced student wellbeing. US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires. In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation. After Musk's Ambani meltdown, Rubio to visit Reliance refinery. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel next week to Mumbai and Gujarat's refinery hub Jamnagar, announced the State Department.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. MP Government Reconstitutes Employees' Commission, Appoints Retired IAS Officer Malay Shrivastava As Chairman. The Madhya Pradesh government has reconstituted the Employees' Commission, appointing retired IAS officer Malay Shrivastava as chairman. Land Gifted To Three Granddaughters, Then Mortgaged For rupees 2 Crore! EOW Registers Bank Fraud Case In Bhopal. Bhopal's Economic Offences Wing registered a cheating case against three family members accused of securing a rupees 2 crore bank loan by mortgaging land previously gifted to three granddaughters through 'Hiba'. MP Air Pollution Under NGT Scanner Ahead Of Winter, Tribunal Seeks Action Report In Two Weeks; Bhopal PM10 Falls, Indore Records Rise. The National Green Tribunal has directed Madhya Pradesh authorities to submit air pollution compliance reports within two weeks ahead of winter. Thieves Strike Inside Bhopal Central Jail Premises, Steal Gold, Silver Jewellery And rupees 35,000 From Guard's House. Thieves broke into a jail guard's locked residence on Bhopal Central Jail premises in Gandhi Nagar, stealing gold and silver jewellery along with rupees 35,000 cash. Big Relief For MP Government Employees Aged 45+, CPCT Scorecard Exemption Granted For Promotion To Assistant Grade 3. The Madhya Pradesh government has exempted Class 4 employees aged 45 and above from submitting CPCT scorecards for departmental promotion to Assistant Grade 3. MP CM Mohan Yadav's Secretariat Has 11 IAS Officers But No Serving IPS Officer After Latest Transfers. Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's Secretariat continues to have 11 IAS officers following the latest bureaucratic reshuffle, including Sukhveer Singh's appointment. Bhopal Durga Idol Processions Witness Police-Participant Clash Over Loud DJ Music, Four Operators Booked. Clashes erupted between police and Durga idol procession participants in Bhopal over loud DJ music near Platinum Plaza and Apex Bank Trisection. MP High Court Upholds State Transport Authority Notification, Dismisses Bus Operators' Petition; Interstate Permit Decisions To Resume. The Madhya Pradesh High Court's Gwalior bench has upheld the validity of the August 10, 2026, notification constituting the State Transport Authority. Madhya Pradesh Home Guard Recruitment 2026 Gets Approval After 18 Years, 5,010 Posts To Be Filled, 488 For Mahakal Temple. The Madhya Pradesh government has approved recruitment of 5,010 Home Guard constables after 18 years, including 488 for Ujjain's Mahakal Temple security. Bhopal Lawyer Found Dead On Railway Tracks, Woman Linked To Him Found Hanging Weeks Later. A 26-year-old woman, Mahi Partani, was found hanging at her Berasia residence in Bhopal, weeks after lawyer Vishal Ramnani was found dead on railway tracks. 'Who Allowed Pandal To Block Entire Road?' Indore High Court Summons DCP Over Gandhi Nagar Road Obstruction. The Madhya Pradesh High Court's Indore bench summoned DCP Narendra Rawat over an allegedly unauthorised pandal blocking Gandhi Nagar's main road. In Madhya Pradesh, cop suspended over 'abuse' of tribal students, CM Mohan Yadav steps in. Video of Bhopal cop abusing tribal students goes viral, officer suspended. Congress Demands Drought-Hit Status For MP's Ujjain Amid Poor Rainfall, Seeks Farmer Relief, Loan Recovery Suspension. Congress leaders in MP's Ujjain demanded drought-hit status for the district, citing deficient rainfall, low groundwater levels and farmer distress. Dark streets in key areas in Bhopal bring safety concerns to light in festive season. MP High Court Rules No Stamp Duty On Contested Property Decrees Recognising Existing Rights, Quashes rupees 32 Lakh Demand. The Madhya Pradesh High Court's Indore bench ruled that contested judicial decrees recognising existing property rights through adverse possession require neither compulsory registration nor stamp duty. Bhopal Man Dies While Out Shopping With Friend. MP to see four days of storms from today: Gwalior-Chambal to be worst hit; Ujjain, Sagar and Rewa divisions. 'How Can Religions Save The World When They Need DJs?' Satirist Sampat Saral Asks In MP's Ujjain. Renowned humour and satire poet Sampat Saral was felicitated by Choupal organisation in MP's Ujjain.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. SBI warns of 30 percent monthly return scams: 4 red flags investors must watch for. Fraudsters use fake testimonials, urgent deadlines and suspicious links to steal savings. Here is how to verify offers and stay safe. Allan Gray Sees Nigeria Rally Broader Than Korea's AI Boom. Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, sees Nigeria's stock rally as more broad-based than South Korea's, offering investors a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia. Jio Platforms set to bring India's biggest IPO on Oct 21, seeks rupees 30,213 cr. The fresh issue comprises up to 270 million equity shares with a face value of rupees 10 each Nifty's 200-day moving average sounds alarm as market breadth thins. Only 10 Nifty 50 stocks traded above their 200-day moving averages on Wednesday, down from 38 in January, signalling weakening market breadth despite movements in the benchmark index. Groww's net profit up 54 percent , equity derivatives' share in revenue dips. Groww's Q2FY27 net profit rose 54 percent to rupees 725.65 crore, while revenue grew 47 percent to rupees 1,501.53 crore. Equity derivatives' share in revenue declined to 44.8 percent from 56.9 percent a year ago. Chip Stocks Deepen Losses as Concerns Mount Over Rates, AI Debt. A rout in global technology hardware stocks extended Thursday, as Asian chipmakers followed US peers lower on worries over Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and AI funding difficulties. Zetwerk raises rupees 2,251 crore from anchor investors ahead of rupees 5,012-cr IPO. The company allotted 14.91 crore equity shares to 99 funds at rupees 151 apiece, the upper end of the price band, according to a circular uploaded on the BSE website Exporter Dollar Sales Bolster Malaysian Ringgit, Analysts Say. Malaysian exporters are likely increasing conversions of their foreign-currency earnings into the ringgit, which stands to boost the local exchange rate through the rest of the year, analysts say. IT's rupees 25K crore market value gain mirrors pharma's loss as Nifty falls. IT and FMCG stocks' rally failed to push up a broader market that fell 0.44 per cent on Wednesday, dragged by pharma stocks even as it gained the previous session. Sebi likely to adopt blended pricing framework to curb expiry-day volatility in derivatives. Sebi reviewed the framework through a consultation paper in September, following pushback from market participants over a liquidity squeeze during the auction. Sebi confirms Rajesh Exports curbs, flags incomplete information in probe. Rajesh Mehta remains barred from dealing in Rajesh Exports securities as Sebi examines financial disclosures, subsidiary consolidation and alleged related-party fund routing. Copper Edges Lower After World's Biggest Mine Averts Strike. Copper slipped after BHP Group's Escondida mine in Chile, the world's largest, averted a strike that would have tightened supply as the industry struggles to keep pace with demand from data centers and power grids. Jio Platforms announces IPO subscription window from October 21 to 23. The anchor investor bidding date is October 19, while the public issue will remain open for three days, from October 21 to October 23, 2026 Hegseth heckled as he vows to stop Iran having nukes. US War Secretary Pete Hegseth emphasized that the United States must act to prevent Iran's nuclear ambitions. Nasdaq ends sharply lower as hot inflation data stirs rate-hike worries. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 6, GRAPHIC):US STOCKS-Nasdaq ends sharply lower as hot inflation data stirs rate-hike worries Sebi proposes market cap-based SME listing norms, lower application size. Sebi proposes halving the minimum SME IPO application value to rupees 1 lakh, raising the operating profit threshold and easing offer-for-sale restrictions for institutional investors Diwali gets less sweet as sugar prices climb higher. Sweets and desserts are experiencing higher prices this festive season due to increasing sugar costs and rising demand. Stocks fall, dollar rallies as US inflation tops forecasts. GLOBAL-MARKETS:Stocks fall, dollar rallies as US inflation tops forecasts Flexibility for AIFs is not relaxation but more responsibility: Sebi WTM. Sebi whole-time member Sandip Pradhan said regulation of private markets will increasingly need to be proportionate, data-driven and risk-based as the sector expands Houthis hit Saudi oil giant as Iran war escalates. Houthi rebels reportedly targeted the headquarters of Saudi Aramco in Dhahran, inflicting damage on upper floors. Bitcoin Slides as Wall Street Risk Pullback Tests Bullish Turn. Bitcoin fell as much as 2.3 percent toward the lower end of its recent trading range, caught in a broader retreat from risk assets even as crypto analysts have turned sharply more bullish on the token. NPS Bharat FoF: Why PFRDA is opening pension capital to private debt. The pension regulator is widening investment options and simplifying digital enrolment to expand retirement coverage. IDBI row: Akhilesh cries 'EOS sale', Nirmala hits back. Finance Minister Sitharaman criticized Akhilesh Yadav's remarks about the IDBI Bank's sale to Fairfax Financial Holdings. Red hot CPI report fuels AI rout. USA-STOCKS/AI (PIX):Red hot CPI report fuels AI rout BHEL gains 5 percent , hits new high post Q2 results; stock up 100 percent in one year. Thus far in the calendar year 2026, BHEL stock outperformed the market by soaring 61 percent compared to a 14.6 percent decline in the BSE Sensex. RaGa-led plea against SIR may be heard in SC. The Supreme Court is likely to hear a petition filed by Rahul Gandhi and 12 other INDIA bloc leaders challenging the Election Commissions decisions on the special intensive revision (SIR) of voter rolls, tomorrow. Dividend, stock split record date: Last chance to buy today - Hindustan Composites, Canara Robeco, HCL and Bansal Wire. Hindustan Composites and Canara Robeco AMC declared interim dividends of rupees 21 and rupees 2 per share, respectively, with October 16, 2026, as the record date. HCL Technologies announced a rupees 12 dividend, while Bansal Wire Industries set the same date for its five-for-one stock split.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. NPS Charges: rupees 20,000 a year on rupees 1 crore corpus; What subscribers should know before investing through PoP. Thinking about joining the National Pension System (NPS)? The choice you make between accessing e-NPS or utilizing a Point of Presence (PoP) can greatly influence your overall costs for years to come. Grasping the fee structures associated with PoP and any potential extra charges is vital for both newcomers and seasoned subscribers. Uncover the best approach for your retirement investments. Sent money to the wrong UPI ID? Here's how to raise a complaint and recover it. Report the transaction through your UPI app and bank immediately to improve your chances of recovering the money NPS investment in startups: AINPSEF writes to PM Modi seeking probe and asks for dissolution of NPS Trust. Manjeet Singh Patel has alleged serious financial irregularities concerning the National Pension System Trust. He has requested a high-level audit by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. Patel asserts that many employees' NPS investments have turned negative due to poor market performance. He demands the implementation of a guaranteed minimum return on employee contributions. US stocks: You receive $75 on a $100 dividend, but India may tax the full amount again; how to claim relief. Indian residents earning dividends from US stocks generally receive payouts after US withholding tax. The full dividend is again taxable in India. Here's how to claim relief. Travel insurance mandatory for all railway passengers including offline tickets bought at rail counters from this date, Supreme Court order; Know how this helps. The Supreme Court of India has ruled that all train tickets must include mandatory travel insurance starting October 27, 2026. This decision applies to both online tickets purchased through IRCTC and offline tickets available at railway counters. The travel insurance will provide significant financial support in the event of accidents or emergencies for passengers. SC makes insurance mandatory for all train tickets from Oct 27; here's what it means for customers booking offline. The Supreme Court has directed Indian Railways to make insurance mandatory for all tickets bought at station counters from October 27, 2026, extending coverage already available optionally to online ticket holders. Details here. Bank holiday on Durga Puja: Bankers in West Bengal urge chief minister to declare October 17 as a holiday. Holiday on Maha Saptami Puja: Bankers in West Bengal are appealing for an additional holiday on October 17 to celebrate Maha Saptami Puja. While days off are currently set from October 18 to 21, the absence of a holiday on the 17th has prompted the All India Bank Officers' Confederation to reach out to Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. Asked to be an executor? Know your duties before you agree. Being an executor involves managing a deceased person's estate, settling liabilities and distributing assets. Here's what the role entails and when you can renounce it. Property tax waiver extended for residents of this part of Delhi: Check the new deadline to pay tax. Delhi property tax: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has introduced SUNIYO 2.0, an amnesty scheme for homeowners with unpaid property taxes. Taxpayers are required to pay only the principal amount for the fiscal years 2025-26 and 2020-21 to 2024-25. All previous interest and penalties for tax dues before 2020-21 will be waived completely. Property owners must take advantage of this scheme before the deadline of December 31, 2026, which has been extended from September 30, 2026. Personal loan closure: How long does it take for your credit score to improve?. A credit score may not rise immediately after the final EMI; lenders must first report the loan closure to credit bureaus. EPFO extends ECR deadline to October 31, 2026: Employers to get 16 more days to file employees' EPF, EPS and EDLI data. The EPFO has extended the September 2026 ECR filing deadline for employers from October 15 to October 31, following the increase in the PF wage ceiling from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000. Employers must calculate contributions using the applicable wage ceilings. Meanwhile, eligible establishments can apply under the EPFO Amnesty Scheme 2026 for retrospective regularisation of exempt PF trusts by December 28, 2026. rupees 1 lakh in your PF account: How much can you withdraw , rupees 25,000, rupees 50,000 or rupees 75,000? Know the rules. EPFO's new EPF rules group partial withdrawals into essential needs, housing and special circumstances, with a 12-month minimum membership requirement. Details here. Wife proves husband's incapacity, wins divorce and rupees 10,000 monthly maintenance: Kerala HC Order explained. Wife wins divorce and rupees 10,000 monthly maintenance after proving husband is incapacitated from having physical relationship; Kerala HC order explained EPF withdrawal rules: Form 121 replaces Forms 15G and 15H from April 2026. From April 1, 2026, Form 121 replaces Forms 15G and 15H for eligible taxpayers seeking TDS relief on specified income, including qualifying EPF withdrawals. Check who can submit the new declaration, its validity and why it does not automatically make taxable withdrawals tax-free. Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yogna: MP CM to release 41st installment today, here's how to check payment. Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister's Ladli Behna Yojana will be released on Wednesday, October 15. About 1.25 crore women will be receiving money transfer of more than rupees 1,834 crore this time. Applying for a passport?
